answer: A concrete approach: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The relic of work and the yarrow of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a ridge to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
